profile.headline: Software Engineer | Legal Technologist
profile.summary:
I build bridges between technology, innovation, and the practical realities of complex industries, particularly law. As a technologist with a JD from Chicago-Kent College of Law and an academic foundation in Philosophy, Spanish, and Critical Thought & Inquiry, my career has always been about solving difficult problems clearly, creatively, and effectively.

In roles ranging from software developer and legal technologist to innovation solutions manager, I've consistently found that seemingly overwhelming business challenges can become manageable through the thoughtful application of technology. I find these challenges exciting to work on, and thrive in applying myself to them fully. Whether it's deploying sophisticated AI-driven workflows, creating intuitive internal tools, or refining processes to improve both human and organizational outcomes, my approach is always hands-on, deeply curious, and pragmatic.

I have significant experience translating complex technical concepts into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences; from senior executives and attorneys to frontline business teams and developers. This ability to speak multiple "languages" allows me to build consensus, drive meaningful change, and ensure that technology serves the organization's real-world needs rather than becoming a solution in search of a problem.

At the intersection of law, innovation, and technology, I strive to empower teams, streamline workflows, and deliver solutions that not only solve today's challenges but anticipate tomorrow's opportunities.

positions.description: Skills: Engineering · Software Design · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Client Relations · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Innovation Solutions Manager
positions.description:
AI Workflow Builder. Designed, coded, and launched internal GenAI tools (ReplyGuy, SALT-e, ObDicta) that cut drafting and review time by 50 %+ and saved $150 K/yr in vendor spend.

Hands-On Development. React + TypeScript front-ends; Python or Node APIs; Claude & GPT-4 LLM integration; FAISS / VoyageAI vector search.

Prompt-Engineering Lead. Drive firm-wide leadership for LLM usage, output QA, and security.

Change Enablement. Ran targeted workshops; >90 attorney users within six months, driving continuous feature feedback loops.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Documentation · Process Improvement

positions.title: Founder and President
positions.description:
Led a small team of full-stack engineers, producing open source software on a distributed computing platform, funded by client work and completion of community bounties.

Developed software as outreach (privacy utilities, backup utilities, communal AI art projects) in addition to compensated work for clients.

Programmed in Hoon, a functional, LISP-like programming language designed for use as an overlay language to Nock, the machine language of Urbit.

positions.title: Legal Technologist
positions.description:
Built Custom Firm Tooling:
- Implemented a “deal capture” process and deal database in Excel, capturing hundreds of information points across hundreds of deals; additionally, developed a visualization tool for the data using Tableau.
- Implemented an IRS Form 990 database (using irsx and irsdb repos on GitHub) and developed a visualization tool for the data using Tableau.
- Developed custom additions to HighQ Collaborate/Publisher front-ends, in JavaScript, including:
  * Custom document automation functionality.
  * Reactive/Dynamic page loading/content surfacing.
- Developed data visualizations across a variety of information streams for use in various departments.
Product Owner and Power User for Technology Tools:
- Data Room Systems (e.g. HighQ, LegalAnywhere)
- Document Automation (e.g. Woodpecker, HotDocs)
- AI/Machine Learning Technologies (e.g. Kira)
- Electronic Signature (e.g. DocuSign)
- BI Tools (Tableau, PowerBI)
Client Portal Expert:
- Led development of several client portals from requirements gathering through product delivery.
- Built custom integrations with Vendor portal software and Excel, using VBA, to decrease administrative overhead.
- Managed improvements in a custom invoice approval system for a large client.
Excel Professional:
- Master Excel user and proficient VBA programmer.
